candidates.change_summary: Change require(msg.value == 1 ether) to require(msg.value == 0 ether).
Change guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 to guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number.
Change guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 to guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 2.
Change guesses[msg.sender].guess = hash to guesses[msg.sender].guess = bytes32(0).
Insert guesses[msg.sender].guess = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(hash)) before the original assignment.
Move require(msg.value == 1 ether) after the assignments.
Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, so the caller receives less ETH on a correct guess.
Change the balance check from 2 ether to 1 ether, causing a revert for correct guesses when contract holds less than 2 ether but at least 1 ether.
Change the blockhash lookup to use block.number instead of the guessed block, making the answer deterministic per call and altering win conditions.
Delete the require that checks block.number > guessed block, allowing settlement in the same block and making the blockhash zero.
